verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs state it offers official client libraries for several programming languages for its API, plus an official React SDK: a component library with built-in payroll business logic. That covers the core of building against official SDKs. Detail is thin: the evidence never names the languages, says how the libraries are maintained, or shows anyone using them. Missing for 10: the list of supported SDK languages, depth on SDK features (typing, versioning alignment, agent-oriented guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
